description: Declares how the on-demand service system can be booked through the quotes and bookings endpoints.

last_updated.description: Last time the data in the feed was updated in POSIX time.

ttl.description: Number of seconds before the data in the feed will be updated again (0 if the data should always be refreshed).

version.description: GOFS version number to which the feed conforms, according to the versioning framework (added in v1.1).

booking_version.description: Version of the booking endpoints implemented by the system, in MAJOR.MINOR format.

booking_types.description: Booking types that can be made through the bookings endpoint, using the booking_type values of booking_rules.json.

quote_validity.description: Minimum number of seconds every quote remains bookable after it is returned.

required_rider_fields.description: Rider fields the system needs to create a booking.

vehicle_location.description: true if the system sends location_changed events and serves bookings/{booking_id}/vehicle_location.

driver_contact.description: How the rider can reach the driver.

accepted_payment_methods.description: Payment methods the rider can use to pay the operator, for display to riders.

support_phone_number.description: Phone number for problems with an active booking.
